what: Hovering a list row where the same name stands over large hollow (outline-only) letters lights that row — the vertical padding opens in .5s, the standing title clears away in .35s, and a row-wide marquee of the same name joined end to end turns on in .3s and flows half a loop every 22 seconds, while the detail strip under the row floats up 8px in .32s and flows backward over 28 seconds (curve cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)). On release the marquee stops and clears. For fingers, tapping lights only that row

options.speed: Marquee half-turn length (seconds), default 22 — the item strip uses --fx-items (default 28s)

note: The inner group of a marquee or item strip must repeat the same text twice for a seamless loop (50% shift). Hollow text is the consumer’s css (-webkit-text-stroke)

from.where: index.html .ow-serv — original Services: row padding .5s ease-out-elegant, titleStatic opacity .35, marqueeOverlay .3, wordTrack 22s linear paused→running, itemsTrack 28s reverse, itemsZone .32/.4
